title: Blocked submissions
description: blocked.json: plugin ids and repositories the submission workflow refuses, for an author who broke the code of conduct or the submission requirements. A listed plugin is removed by deleting its entry, this only keeps it from coming back.

repositories.description: GitHub repositories as <owner>/<repo>, compared without regard to case.

reasons.description: Why a plugin id or repository is blocked, who blocked it and when, keyed by the id or <owner>/<repo>.
